args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only and unhealthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows v2.3.0 healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
